terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use object-space dimensions and observable exterior construction; never invent an interior.

objectClass.primaryType: raised exterior-only marsh inn and provision house
objectClass.notes: Geometry is reconstructed from the four admitted crops; the rejected whole-sheet mask is not used.

reasoning: The broad raised body, deep porch and bent roof are co-equal macro forms.
The side counter, reed sign, dormer, chimney and attached fishing clutter provide the service read.
Hidden roof underside and sign thickness use conservative inferred geometry.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Multi-angle service geometry and porch negative space must remain explicit before the final two-bucket merge.

detailInventory.scanMethod: four admitted component-zone crops with hero cross-check

definitionOfDone: A floor-seated 9 by 8.8 by 8 yard shell reads as the Crooked Reed Inn from all four views and preserves the clear local x=-2.8 porch entrance/service approach.

featureGroups.name: Raised broad inn and bent roof
qualityCriteria: Broad width, lifted floor, chimney and bent ridge remain legible.

featureGroups.name: Deep porch and clear entrance
qualityCriteria: Posts, steps, undercroft and rope rail create real depth without blocking entry.

featureGroups.name: Provision counter and rain awning
qualityCriteria: Counter remains attached and readable from the civic-facing side.

featureGroups.name: Swamp material and warm-light separation
qualityCriteria: Timber, stone, teal roof, rope and amber glazing remain distinct.

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not replace the bent roof with a straight generic gable.
Keep all service clutter attached and exterior.

assumptions: The approved output is a stylized approximation, not photogrammetry.
The unseen roof underside and reed-bundle back use simple watertight depth.
Barrel, crate and rope counts are fixed to a representative arrangement where generated views disagree.

silhouette.boundingShape: broad two-level timber mass raised above a deep porch beneath a tall sagging teal gable
silhouette.symmetry: near-symmetric main shell with asymmetric chimney, sign and service counter

componentTree.name: Raised timber inn shell and piling base
componentTree.topologyRationale: The visible body is a closed collection of planar timber wall bays seated above stone and piling blocks.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: raised porch and shell on alternating stone-capped posts with visible gaps
timber posts divide dark vertical plank wall panels

componentTree.name: Bent teal roof, dormer and chimney
componentTree.topologyRationale: The roof is a layered faceted shell with a shallow concave ridge, projecting eaves and separate masonry chimney.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: three faceted roof bands create a low center and kicked tips
stepped teal courses project beyond a dark timber fascia
central gabled dormer with chunky amber pane grid
wide stacked dark-stone chimney with projecting cap

componentTree.name: Full-width porch, posts, steps and rope rail
componentTree.topologyRationale: Deck boards, posts, steps and rails are discrete rigid construction members with intentional open gaps.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: faceted rope spans and one shallow half-torus net sag
four broad stone steps align exactly to the entrance at local x=-2.8

componentTree.name: Exterior provision counter and canvas rain awning
componentTree.topologyRationale: The counter, backboard and shallow cloth plane are attached facade volumes rather than an accessible interior.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: teal sloped canopy projects above a closed timber sales counter
attached barrel and crate silhouettes frame but do not block the counter

componentTree.name: Hanging reed-bundle sign and timber gallows
componentTree.topologyRationale: The sign is a bound cluster of repeated tapered reeds suspended from a short rigid gallows.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: six tapered reed slats gather under two rope bands with no text or emblem

componentTree.name: Amber facade windows and lantern pair
componentTree.topologyRationale: Warm panes and lantern cages are shallow repeated facade relief backed by emissive geometry.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: warm inset panes remain divided by dark timber muntins

materials.name: Merged Fenbridge opaque vertex-color material
materials.shaderModel: MeshStandardMaterial on Standard/Ultra; semantic vertex-color Lambert-compatible Low path

albedo.samplingNotes: Reference values define semantic families; baked studio highlights are not copied.

localOverrides.region: wall boards, porch members and trim
localOverrides.pattern: axial low-frequency grain with darker lower damp band

localOverrides.region: eave course crests and ridge tips

albedo.samplingNotes: Restrained amber panes, no punctual lights embedded.

repetitionSystems.method: fixed repeated primitives merged by semantic bucket
repetitionSystems.geometry: box posts plus faceted rope spans

repetitionSystems.method: fixed shallow pane and muntin modules
repetitionSystems.drawCallPolicy: opaque frame plus emissive pane merge

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: studio-lit concept pixels provide material-family evidence, not exact inverse-rendered maps

screenshotReview: Compare fixed front and hero silhouettes.
Check porch negative space at player scale.
Check teal roof, timber and amber separation on Low and Ultra.

lightingFromPhoto: Neutral upper-left key light reveals roof courses without copying baked highlights; exposure 1.0 with ACES tone mapping.
Soft frontal fill preserves dark timber construction and amber-pane separation.
Neutral environment rim plus floor contact shadow proves porch-pile seating and counter depth.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Review only identity-defining grouped systems from the same comparison pair.

specRefineTriggers: counter or reed sign not exterior-readable
codeRefineTriggers: model diverges from a sound component contract
stopCriteria: all critical features score at least 0.70
new reference required for unresolved hidden geometry

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: reference, render, comparison sheet and feature scores
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: match each admitted crop to the same camera

featureReviewTargets.name: Broad raised body, bent teal roof, chimney and dormer
Deep porch, open undercroft, rope rail and local x=-2.8 entrance steps
Attached provision counter and teal rain awning
Dark timber, damp stone, teal roof and amber window separation
Barrels, crates, net and rope remain attached and bounded
Exterior-only model stays within 5,200 triangles and 350 KiB

buildPasses.goal: Lock native bounds and macro silhouette.
acceptance: Raised broad silhouette and bent roof match front and hero crops.
All exterior systems are attached and the central approach remains clear.

buildPasses.goal: Add observed roof, rope, dormer, sign and cargo geometry.
acceptance: Every inventoried component detail has implemented geometry.

buildPasses.goal: Apply semantic colors and two-bucket material response.
acceptance: Low and Ultra retain timber, stone, roof and amber separation.

buildPasses.goal: Verify clear porch, service apron and runtime-owned collision intent.
acceptance: No attached clutter blocks the standing points or steps.
At most two primitives, no interior, at most 5,200 triangles and 350 KiB.

actionReadiness.contract: Static exterior hierarchy with stable service and entrance sockets; gameplay collision remains runtime-owned.

performanceBudget.texturePolicy: three shared external Fenbridge support maps; no embedded raster texture

proceduralStrategy: Build a closed timber shell and raised porch from boxes.
Approximate the bent roof with bounded faceted roof bands and kicked trim.
Use fixed repeated primitives for posts, rails, windows and reeds.
Merge all opaque and emissive geometry into the two shipping buckets.
risks: Whole-sheet fragmentation makes only isolated crops authoritative.
Generated views disagree on small clutter counts; the fixed shipping arrangement is intentionally representative.
The material recipe is reference-informed and stylized, not exact inverse rendering.
